lemmas.primary_translation: to find one's bearings; to settle in; to familiarize oneself with something; to get an overview; to direct one's attention, interest, or sympathy in a particular direction

definitions.translation: to find out where one is

examples.no: orientere seg ved hjelp av kart og kompass
examples.en: to find one's way using a map and compass

examples.no: jeg har problem med å orientere meg i storbyen
examples.en: I have trouble finding my way around the big city

definitions.translation: to get an overview of the main points

examples.no: jeg sliter med å orientere meg i alle arbeidsoppgavene
examples.en: I struggle to get an overview of all the work tasks

examples.no: det er enkelt å orientere seg på den nye nettsiden
examples.en: it is easy to find one's way around the new website

definitions.text: vende oppmerksomhet, interesse eller sympati i en bestemt retning
definitions.translation: to direct one's attention, interest, or sympathy in a particular direction

examples.no: bedriften orienterer seg mot nye kundegrupper
examples.en: the company is directing its attention and interest toward new customer groups
